intent: Execute the seq108 bounded search for a directly comparable realized full-year 2024 QLC-enterprise-SSD or enterprise-SSD shipment volume in EB and/or units. Prioritize later TrendForce methodological-primary material that could evaluate the April 2024 30 EB QLC-enterprise-SSD Judgment. If no directly comparable public methodological-primary measurement is recovered at bounded depth, persist the unresolved search result and advance without synthesizing an Outcome.
rationale_summary: The TrendForce expectation-to-quarterly-Reality trajectory is already grounded and production-executed. The only material unresolved Outcome is an annual absolute-volume measurement comparable to the April 30 EB QLC-enterprise-SSD forecast. Existing search-depth, source/Evidence and Judgment/Outcome owners can close or explicitly preserve that gap; no new architecture or predicate is justified without a matching realized source.
